character.description: hooded cyan and teal magical adventurer, south-facing combat animation

idle.action: subtle breathing, feet fixed on a shared baseline

walk.action: clear four-step walk cycle with planted contacts and stable cloak volume

dash.action: crouch, launch, low dash, then balanced stop; full body remains visible

bless_cast.action: raise both hands and channel a blessing without detached effects

hit.action: brief readable recoil, then regain balance

death.action: controlled fall onto the ground without detached limbs or props
